name: button
title: Button
description: Tactile interactive button with quintic micro-spring physics, restrained contrast variants, and integrated loading indicators.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Renders an ambient spinning indicator and disables interaction

examples.title: Primary & Secondary Pair
examples.description: Standard high-priority action paired with a secondary alternative.

examples.title: With Icons & Loading
examples.description: Button with icons and dynamic loading spinner.
examples.code:
<Button variant="outline" leftIcon={<Download className="w-4 h-4" />}>Export Schema</Button>
<Button isLoading variant="default">Deploying</Button>

accessibility.implementation: Fully reachable via Tab with standard focus-visible ring (ring-1 ring-ring/50).
Uses disabled attribute and pointer-events-none; prevents all click and tap events.

designRules.rationale: High contrast solid fills and warm neutrals maintain system atmosphere.
Micro-spring must strictly use stiffness 400 and damping 25.

name: icon-button
title: Icon Button
description: Compact square or circular icon action with micro-spring interaction and mandatory accessibility labels.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Screen reader label describing the action

props.name: isActive
props.description: Applies active background fill and accent border

examples.title: Standard Toolbar Actions
examples.description: Icon buttons used in navigation bars and micro-toolbars.
examples.code:
<IconButton icon={<Search className="w-4 h-4" />} aria-label="Search" variant="ghost" />
<IconButton icon={<Sun className="w-4 h-4" />} aria-label="Toggle theme" variant="secondary" />

accessibility.implementation: aria-label is strictly required by TypeScript props.

designRules.rule: Always pair with tooltip if meaning is non-obvious
designRules.rationale: Prevents cognitive ambiguity in dense toolbars.

name: input
title: Input
description: Framed text input with subtle border transition, quiet focus ring, and optional icon slots.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Icon placed inside the left padding

props.name: rightAddon
props.description: Element or action rendered on the right edge

props.name: hasError
props.description: Applies subtle destructive tint to border and ring

examples.title: Search with Icon and Shortcut Addon
examples.description: Input configured for omnibar search.
examples.code: } placeholder="Filter registry..." rightAddon={⌘K} />

accessibility.implementation: Wrap with associated label or provide aria-label.

designRules.rule: Never introduce loud neon focus outlines
designRules.rationale: Focus ring must be ring-1 ring-ring/40, preserving typography hierarchy.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multiline textual input matching the restrained input frame and typography rhythm.

examples.title: Prompt Note Input
examples.description: Textarea used for prompts or technical comments.
examples.code: <Textarea placeholder="Describe the system architecture requirements..." rows={4} />

accessibility.implementation: Pairs with aria-describedby for validation error hints.

designRules.rationale: Maintain Inter font-family with line-height 1.5.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: Compact metadata chip for categories, monospace tracking, and environmental status indicators.

examples.title: Metadata Tags & Status Indicators
examples.description: Badges in different roles.
examples.code:
<Badge variant="mono">TypeScript 5.7</Badge>
<Badge variant="status" status="success">Operational</Badge>
<Badge variant="engraved">Kernel</Badge>
<Badge variant="tactile">Active</Badge>

accessibility.implementation: Never rely solely on dot color; always include textual status label.

designRules.rationale: Use muted background fills so badges do not compete with buttons.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: Delicate 1px hairline division line for establishing vertical and horizontal rhythm.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Whether the separator is purely visual or structural

examples.title: Horizontal and Vertical Dividers
examples.description: Dividing content rows and toolbar items.
examples.code: Home Docs

accessibility.implementation: Sets role='separator' and aria-orientation unless decorative is true.

designRules.rationale: Thick dividers break editorial rhythm.

name: card
title: Card
description: Structured editorial surface with warm card fill, delicate border, and composable header, content, and footer sections.

props.name: hoverable
props.description: Enables delicate border darkening on hover (hover:border-foreground/20)

examples.title: Project or Feature Card
examples.description: Card composed with title, description, content, and footer actions.
examples.code:
Component Architecture Pipeline Resilient event-driven state machine.

Built with Rust and WebSockets.

 2026

accessibility.implementation: CardTitle uses h3 by default to maintain semantic document outline.

designRules.rationale: Cards rely on hairline borders and warm background contrast.

name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: Floating pill navigation bar with backdrop blur, sliding active pill indicator, and responsive mobile drawer.

props.name: brand
props.description: Brand logo or home icon trigger

props.name: items
props.description: List of navigation items with id, label, href

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned utility actions like theme toggle

examples.title: Floating Pill Navbar
examples.description: Standard top navigation bar with active state animation.
examples.code: dia-ui} items={[ { id: 'foundations', label: 'Foundations', href: '/foundations' }, { id: 'components', label: 'Components', href: '/components' }, ]} actions={} />

accessibility.implementation: Uses semantic header and nav elements with accessible mobile menu toggle.

designRules.rationale: Sliding pill communicates spatial continuity between active items.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: Hierarchical navigation sidebar with uppercase category headings, active route highlights, and metadata tags.

examples.title: Documentation Sidebar
examples.description: Grouped navigation for foundations and components.
examples.code:
<Sidebar
  groups={[
    {
      title: 'Foundations',
      items: [
        { id: 'colors', label: 'Colors', href: '/foundations#colors' },
        { id: 'typography', label: 'Typography', href: '/foundations#typography' }
      ]
    },
    {
      title: 'Components',
      items: [
        { id: 'button', label: 'Button', href: '/components/button', badge: 'v1.0' },
        { id: 'card', label: 'Card', href: '/components/card' }
      ]
    }
  ]}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Uses semantic aside and ul lists for predictable screen reader navigation.

designRules.rule: Category titles must be uppercase text-sidebar-category
designRules.rationale: Maintains editorial visual weight distribution.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Quiet micro-pill floating hint with delayed reveal, keyboard focus support, and inverted contrast.

examples.title: Icon Button Tooltip
examples.description: Hint on an icon button trigger.
examples.code:
<Tooltip content="Search Registry (⌘K)">
  <IconButton icon={<Search className="w-4 h-4" />} aria-label="Search" />
</Tooltip>

accessibility.implementation: Uses role='tooltip' and activates on both mouse hover and keyboard focus.

designRules.rationale: Tooltips are micro-hints, not modal dialogs.

name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Context menu with backdrop blur, click-outside dismissal, shortcut badges, and accessible keyboard navigation.

examples.title: Action Menu Dropdown
examples.description: Dropdown with labels, separators, and shortcut badges.
examples.code:
<Dropdown>
  <DropdownTrigger>
    <Button variant="secondary" rightIcon={<ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}>Options</Button>
  </DropdownTrigger>
  <DropdownContent>
    <DropdownLabel>Actions</DropdownLabel>
    <DropdownItem icon={<Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} shortcut="⌘C">Copy Code</DropdownItem>
    <DropdownSeparator />
    <DropdownItem destructive icon={<Trash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}>Delete</DropdownItem>
  </DropdownContent>
</Dropdown>

accessibility.implementation: Provides role='menu' and role='menuitem' with aria-expanded on trigger.

designRules.rule: Use backdrop blur and 1px sidebar border
designRules.rationale: Matches portfolio quick-menu styling seamlessly.

name: command-palette
title: Command Palette
description: Global quick launcher modal with real-time query filtering, category grouping, arrow key navigation, and Cmd+K support.

props.name: items
props.description: Command entries with title, category, shortcut, onSelect

examples.title: Global Command Launcher
examples.description: Invoking the command palette with Cmd+K.
examples.code:
<CommandPalette
  isOpen={isCommandOpen}
  onClose={() => setIsCommandOpen(false)}
  items={[
    { id: '1', title: 'Go to Foundations', category: 'Navigation', shortcut: 'G F', onSelect: () => router.push('/foundations') },
    { id: '2', title: 'Toggle Theme', category: 'Appearance', shortcut: 'T', onSelect: toggleTheme },
  ]}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Escape closes immediately; Up/Down keys cycle through results with visible focus.

designRules.rule: Always include status bar helper hints
designRules.rationale: Guides user on keyboard shortcuts for effortless interaction.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: Mechanical tactile rocker switch with recessed well, physical spring travel, and keyboard accessibility.

examples.title: Tactile Toggle Pair
examples.description: Switches with label pairs for system settings.
examples.code: Ambient Atmosphere

accessibility.implementation: Uses role='switch' and aria-checked with Space / Enter key activation.

designRules.rationale: Tactile switch must sit inside a milled well to convey mechanical realism.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Tangible continuous track slider with recessed milled well, progress fill, and elevated cylindrical knob.

examples.title: Audio Gain / Brightness Slider
examples.description: Continuous slider controlling numerical parameters.
examples.code: Grain Opacity 25%

accessibility.implementation: Provides role='slider' with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, and aria-valuemax.

designRules.rationale: Physical slider thumb slides within a tactile recessed rail.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: 3D mechanical keycap profile with tactile light rim, bottom bevel, and physical sink on press.

examples.title: Hotkey Clusters
examples.description: Mechanical keys indicating shortcuts.
examples.code: ⌘ K

accessibility.implementation: Uses standard HTML <kbd> element for assistive technology awareness.

designRules.rationale: Bottom bevel simulates physical mechanical keycap sink.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Segmented tactile control deck with recessed track well and elevated sliding pill indicator.

examples.title: Segmented Tab Deck
examples.description: Tabs with spring-animated sliding pill indicator.
examples.code:
<Tabs defaultValue="overview">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="specs">Specifications</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="logs">Changelog</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="overview">Overview Content</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

accessibility.implementation: Uses role='tablist', role='tab', and role='tabpanel' with keyboard selection.

designRules.rationale: Segmented tabs must sit inside recessed track for physical depth.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Tactile checkbox with recessed well track, micro-spring checkmark expansion, and support for indeterminate states.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Renders a horizontal dash for mixed states

examples.title: Interactive Checkbox Pair
examples.description: Tactile checkbox with descriptive labels.
examples.code: <Checkbox label="Enforce Strict TLS 1.3" description="Drops unencrypted packets at edge" defaultChecked />

accessibility.implementation: Uses role='checkbox' with aria-checked='true|false|mixed' and Space key activation.

designRules.rationale: Unchecked state rests inside tactile well for physical sink feel.

name: radio
title: Radio Group
description: Tactile radio group with spherical concave dish wells and spring-expanded dot indicators.

examples.title: Option Selection Group
examples.description: Radio group with multiple choices.
examples.code:
<RadioGroup defaultValue="opt-1">
  <RadioGroupItem value="opt-1" label="Fastest Ingress" description="Routes through closest POP" />
  <RadioGroupItem value="opt-2" label="Lowest Cost" description="Prefers off-peak backhaul" />
</RadioGroup>

accessibility.implementation: Uses role='radiogroup' and role='radio' with Arrow navigation.

designRules.rationale: Must remain perfectly circular with tactile concave shadow.

name: gauge
title: Gauge
description: Precision analog radial meter with SVG arc, tick marks, digital readout, and fluid spring animations.

examples.title: CPU Load Dial
examples.description: Radial dial monitoring processor saturation.
examples.code: <Gauge value={72} label="CPU UTIL" unit="%" variant="accent" size={140} />

accessibility.implementation: Can be paired with role='meter' and aria-valuenow.

designRules.rationale: An open bottom arc evokes industrial analog meters without obscuring readout.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: Compact zero-dependency SVG micro-trendline with cubic Bézier smoothing, gradient underfill, and live pulse dot.

examples.title: Inline Stat Trend
examples.description: Compact trend inside metric badge or table cell.
examples.code: <Sparkline data={[12, 19, 15, 27, 34, 42]} width={100} height={28} color="#10b981" />

accessibility.implementation: SVG has role='img' and aria-label describing trend.

designRules.rationale: Stroke width must remain between 1.5px and 2px to avoid visual heaviness.

name: area-chart
title: Area Chart
description: Zero-dependency responsive SVG spline chart with cubic Bézier curves, soft gradient fills, gridlines, and precision hover crosshair.

examples.title: Network Bandwidth Chart
examples.description: Interactive spline chart with floating hover tooltip.
examples.code:
<AreaChart
  data={[
    { label: '00:00', value: 120 },
    { label: '04:00', value: 240 },
    { label: '08:00', value: 380 },
    { label: '12:00', value: 510 },
    { label: '16:00', value: 430 }
  ]}
  height={220}
  color="#38bdf8"
/>

accessibility.implementation: Include textual summary or screen-reader table for visual charts.

designRules.rationale: Area underfill must use opacity decay (0.28 to 0) to avoid masking gridlines.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: Tactile column bar chart with recessed background tracks, rounded caps, hover highlight, and spring physics.

examples.title: Frequency Spectrum Bars
examples.description: Octave frequency distribution with tactile tracks.
examples.code:
<BarChart
  data={[
    { label: '60Hz', value: 40 },
    { label: '250Hz', value: 85 },
    { label: '1kHz', value: 70 },
    { label: '4kHz', value: 90 },
    { label: '16kHz', value: 35 }
  ]}
  height={200}
  barColor="#f59e0b"
/>

accessibility.implementation: Bars include hover targets and descriptive tooltips.

designRules.rationale: Columns must sit within recessed background tracks for physical depth.

name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
description: Tactile split verification code input with recessed key wells, auto-focus progression, clipboard paste support, and full keyboard navigation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface tier: clean default, raised tactile, or milled recessed well

props.name: mask
props.description: Hides numeric characters behind privacy dots

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Callback triggered when all digits are populated

examples.title: Tactile Verification Code
examples.description: 6-digit verification code with tactile keycap depth and clipboard support.
examples.code:
<OtpInput
  length={6}
  variant="tactile"
  onComplete={(code) => console.log('Entered code:', code)}
/>

examples.title: Recessed Well Tier
examples.description: Milled surface tier for high-security pin entry.
examples.code:
<OtpInput
  length={4}
  variant="recessed"
  size="lg"
  hasSeparator={false}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Each slot carries aria-label with positional index (e.g. Digit 1 of 6).
Supports Left and Right arrow keys for slot jumping, Backspace for backwards deletion.

designRules.rule: Never outline with saturated neon rings
designRules.rationale: Focus states must rely on restrained rim contrast and subtle elevation.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
description: Surface card illuminated by environmental ambient light that follows the cursor, revealing surface texture and subtle edge chamfering without decorative glow.

props.name: variant
props.description: Base elevation and surface depth tier

props.name: spotlightSize
props.description: Radius in pixels for the ambient radial falloff

props.name: ambientIntensity
props.description: Max opacity of the ambient radial light

examples.title: Ambient Illuminated Card
examples.description: Quiet surface card revealing edge chamfers as the pointer traverses.
examples.code:
<SpotlightCard variant="tactile">
  <SpotlightCardHeader>
    <SpotlightCardTitle>Environmental Sensor</SpotlightCardTitle>
    <SpotlightCardDescription>Thermal and airflow metrics</SpotlightCardDescription>
  </SpotlightCardHeader>
  <SpotlightCardContent>
    Ambient atmosphere is treated as a global condition.
  </SpotlightCardContent>
</SpotlightCard>

accessibility.implementation: Card contents remain 100% readable and contrast-compliant when pointer is outside.

designRules.rule: Ambient light must never trace or outline borders with bright neon
designRules.rationale: Light behaves as an ambient condition, not as decoration.

name: folder-preview
title: Folder Preview
description: Architectural archival document folder with a fanned interactive stack deck that expands to reveal bundled technical sheets.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the archival folder bundle

props.name: files
props.description: Array of files or sheets nested in the stack

examples.title: Archival Blueprint Folder
examples.description: Interactive folder with fanned sheets previewing technical specifications.
examples.code:
<FolderPreview
  title="Subsystem Architecture"
  category="SCHEMATICS 2026"
  files={[
    { id: '1', title: 'Compute Core Specification', subtitle: 'v2.4 Final' },
    { id: '2', title: 'Memory Bus Topologies', subtitle: '400 Gbps interconnect' },
    { id: '3', title: 'Thermal Envelope Study', subtitle: 'Chamber testing' }
  ]}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Cards in the stack can be selected and inspected via standard keyboard focus.

designRules.rule: Motion must be slow and non-intrusive
designRules.rationale: Rotational offsets must stay under 2 degrees to avoid cartoonish angles.

name: magnetic-tabs
title: Magnetic Tabs
description: Segmented tab control deck featuring a fluid spring-driven pill indicator, badge counters, and keyboard navigation.

examples.title: Segmented Control Deck
examples.description: Segmented navigation with tactile pill and status counters.
examples.code:
<MagneticTabs
  variant="tactile"
  tabs={[
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
    { id: 'telemetry', label: 'Telemetry', badge: '12' },
    { id: 'deployments', label: 'Deployments', badge: 'Active' }
  ]}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Uses role='tablist', role='tab', aria-selected, and arrow key navigation.

designRules.rule: Never bounce or overshoot with excessive spring
designRules.rationale: Active pill travel must use high damping (damping 30, stiffness 380) for calm precision.

name: stack-deck
title: Stack Deck
description: Layered physical card deck with depth perspective, cycling controls, and spring-physics reordering.

props.name: cards
props.description: Array of cards to display in the deck

examples.title: Architectural Spec Deck
examples.description: Multi-sheet card deck for sequential inspection.
examples.code:
<StackDeck
  cards={[
    { id: '01', title: 'Structural Envelope', tag: 'Core', description: 'Thermal isolation and seismic damping specifications.' },

    { id: '03', title: 'Power Distribution', tag: 'Power', description: 'Redundant dual-feed 48V direct-to-die converters.' }
  ]}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Previous and Next icon buttons provide clear aria-labels and keyboard focus.

designRules.rule: Card displacement must feel physical and calm
designRules.rationale: Z-index cascading and subtle y-offset convey depth without chaotic sliding.

name: dot-matrix-chart
title: Dot Matrix Chart
description: Equalizer-style dot grid histogram comparing temporal periods with interactive column hover tooltips and architectural mono typography.

props.name: columns
props.description: Array of dot columns with counts and values

examples.description: Period comparison with dot equalizer visualization.

<DotMatrixChart

  metric="+326%"
  previousLabel="MAY $3,250"
  currentLabel="JUN $12,392"
/>

accessibility.implementation: Hover and focus states reveal precise numerical values via tooltips.

designRules.rule: Use muted opacity for historical comparison
designRules.rationale: Maintains visual hierarchy without competing for primary focus.

name: tactile-trend-card
title: Tactile Trend Card
description: Deep charcoal tactile card featuring organic spline curve, vertical dashed year grid, keyword pills, glowing end marker, and velocity delta.

examples.title: Protocol Volume Trend
examples.description: Organic spline wave with keyword velocity.

<TactileTrendCard
  title="Protocol Velocity"
  keywords={["Batch auction", "Liquid staking"]}
  metricValue="824"
  metricDeltaSuperscript="+334"
  percentageDelta="34.4%"
/>

accessibility.implementation: Maintains clear optical contrast ratios against dark charcoal surface.

designRules.rationale: Light behaves as an environmental presence, never a harsh outline.

name: tactile-metric-card
title: Tactile Metric Card

props.name: nodes
props.description: Trajectory node data with tooltip details

designRules.rule: Stripe indicators must be subtle capsules
designRules.rationale: Vertical color accents highlight metric type without visual fatigue.

name: rail-sidebar
title: Rail Sidebar

props.name: items
props.description: Array of navigation items with icons and shortcuts

examples.title: Architectural Studio Rail
examples.description: Compact monolithic rail with keyboard hints and live pulse.

<RailSidebar

/>

designRules.rule: Sidebar must be quiet and tactile
designRules.rationale: Physical well depressions convey interaction state without noisy animations.

name: studio-sidebar
title: Studio Sidebar

props.description: Array of categorized navigation item groups

examples.title: Collapsible Studio Navigation

examples.code:

  activeId="overview"

  environmentName="Production · us-east"

name: segmented-control
title: Segmented Control
description: Physical tactile well track with recessed depth, smooth spring sliding pill, and full keyboard accessibility.

props.name: options
props.description: Array of options with value, label, optional icon, and optional badge

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Expands options to fill available track width

name: knob

props.name: showGrid
props.description: Renders concentric polygonal web rings and spokes

props.name: showLabels

name: analytics-heatmap
title: Analytics Heatmap
description: Temporal activity density matrix with calibrated monochromatic opacity steps, interactive hover inspection, and atmospheric header telemetry.

props.name: data
props.description: Array of daily cells with date, count, and density level (0 to 4)

props.name: title
props.description: Title displayed above the heatmap grid

props.name: totalLabel

props.name: color

examples.title: Temporal Execution Density
examples.description: Annual activity matrix displaying distributed node verifications.

<AnalyticsHeatmap

designRules.rationale: Opacity steps must scale strictly from 5% to 85% to preserve system contrast without blinding saturation.

name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick Chart
description: Financial and telemetry OHLC candlestick chart with high/low wicks, bullish/bearish chassis bodies, integrated volume histogram, and hover crosshair.

props.name: data
props.description: Array of OHLC candle points with time, open, high, low, close, and volume

props.name: height
props.description: Height of SVG charting canvas in pixels

props.name: showVolume
props.description: Renders proportional volume histogram bars at bottom of canvas

examples.title: Financial Telemetry Stream
examples.description: Real-time OHLC candlestick price action with volume bars and floating inspection HUD.
examples.code:
<CandlestickChart
  height={300}
  data={candleData}
  showVolume={true}
  unit="$"
/>

accessibility.implementation: Crosshair hover reveals exact Open, High, Low, Close, and Volume in an accessible floating HUD.

designRules.rationale: Bullish and bearish tones must use restrained emerald/rose values with dark backgrounds, avoiding harsh eye fatigue.

name: ai-churning
title: AI Churning Loader
description: Quantum pixel-matrix and phosphor cell state loader with chevron wavefronts, orbital laps, live tabular elapsed timer, and shimmering ambient phase label.

props.name: showTimer
props.description: Renders live tabular elapsed timer in mono figures

examples.title: Wavefront Churning State
examples.description: Tactile pixel loader with live timer and shimmering label.
examples.code:
<AiChurning
  label="Synthesizing architecture"
  sublabel="Evaluating consensus constraints"
  pattern="wavefront"
  variant="tactile"
  showTimer={true}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Implements role='status' with dynamic aria-label containing label and elapsed time.

designRules.rationale: Phosphor cells and text shimmer must use soft grayscale contrasts without focal neon saturation.

name: ai-thinking
title: AI Thinking Trace
description: Architectural expandable reasoning trace accordion with duration counter, categorized tabs (Steps, Reasoning, Search, Coding), and execution step cards.

props.name: steps
props.description: Array of execution steps with status, duration, and details

props.name: reasoningText
props.description: Narrative explanation of architectural decision making

props.name: codeExecutions
props.description: Code snippets evaluated with outputs and latency

examples.title: Architectural Reasoning Trace
examples.description: Collapsible thinking container with step-by-step verification cards.
examples.code:
<AiThinking
  status="completed"
  duration="3.8s"
  steps={steps}
  reasoningText="Evaluating boundary conditions for low-latency buffer allocation."
/>

accessibility.implementation: Header button manages aria-expanded state and keyboard accessibility.

designRules.rationale: Reasoning logs provide deep context without visual clutter; springs must use stiffness 320, damping 28.

name: ai-streaming-text
title: AI Streaming Text
description: Response streaming container with ambient blinking cursor, interactive inline citation chips with hover source popovers, and follow-up suggestion pills.

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: Renders ambient pulsing streaming cursor at end of text

props.name: sources
props.description: Array of citations with domain, title, snippet, and confidence score

props.name: onFollowUpClick
props.description: Callback when user clicks a follow-up prompt pill

examples.title: Streamed Answer with Citations
examples.description: AI response with inline source badges and follow-up prompt chips.
examples.code:
<AiStreamingText
  content="Catmull-Rom cubic splines pass directly through control points, avoiding overshoot."
  sources={sources}
  followUps={['Benchmark performance', 'Export TypeScript']}
/>

accessibility.implementation: Content remains readable via standard DOM text nodes; citations provide accessible titles.

designRules.rationale: Pulsing streaming cursor must be subtle without sharp jitter or high contrast.
